ground: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating ground texture for an existing mobile top-down hand-painted 2D fantasy survival game. Image 1 is a STYLE reference only, not an edit target. Generate a new square 1024x1024 seamless tile: a quiet softly painted meadow ground viewed from above, desaturated sage olive grass interspersed with a few broad softly irregular ochre soil and pale dry-grass areas. Broad flowing value masses with very sparse short blade marks. Flat navigable surface, no horizon, no cast lighting gradients, no objects, no flowers, no rocks, no trails that imply a route, no text, no grid. Keep contrast low, medium-light warm green value, distinctly quieter and less densely textured than the reference. Absolutely seamless on all four edges; no vignette, no central motif or borders. Fine brushwork without blurry photographic noise. The tile will be displayed over 512 world units and augmented with separate sparse decorative sprite props.
props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2 by 2 game environment sprite atlas, square 1024x1024 with actual transparent alpha. Reference images are STYLE references only: match the existing hand-painted 2D fantasy top-down game, slightly oblique view showing tops and front surfaces, upper-left lighting, restrained dark plum outlines. Four separate small decorative ground sprites, one centered in each exact 512x512 quadrant: top-left one low irregular tuft of sage grass; top-right a small cluster of three flat mossy grey stones; bottom-left a low clump of dry golden meadow grass; bottom-right a tiny grass clump with three muted ivory wildflowers. All are quiet low-contrast scenery, no glossy highlights or bright neon, no tall bushes or trees, no magical rings or symbols, no chest/item resemblance. Each sprite occupies only the central 65% of its quadrant with generous transparent margins, fully separated, no touching or crossing cells. Real transparent background everywhere between sprites. No ground tile or backing, no checkerboard painted into the image, no lettering, no frame or grid lines, no numbers. Crisp hand-painted broad shapes that remain readable at only 18–38 CSS pixels in-game. Very short soft contact shadow directly underneath each sprite, no long shadows. Preserve a coherent palette and scale, each quadrant one object group.
sourceLocation: Workspace art-originals/field1; generated PNGs preserved separately from optimized WebP assets.
groundRevision: Natural irregular ochre earth patches, 18 percent coverage, hand-painted feathered edges; preserve seamless overhead meadow and quiet palette.
